item.description:

item.title: Night Before Christmas at Strasburg Rail Road — Fri Nov 27, 6:30 PM — Strasburg Rail Road
item.description: Join us at Strasburg Rail Road for a cozy evening tradition that has been around for almost 15 years and is certain to become a yearly ritual for your family as well! Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. item.title: LFS Monthly Discussion - El Serrano's — Wed Feb 3, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Lancaster Freethought Society Come joins us for intelligent discussion and freethinking fun at our monthly meeting. Lancaster Freethought Society is a community for Freethinkers, Atheists, Agnostics, Humanists, Non-believers, Skeptics, and those who are simply curious. There is no fee to attend our meetings which range from topical subjects of interest to freethinkers such as Church/State Separation, as well as subjects such as science, philosophy, ethics, counter-apologetics, and psychology. All are welcome to attend no matter what your beliefs may be but proselytizing is not allowed. Bring your articles, news, jokes, gripes, questions, ideas, topics, or anything else you would like to discuss with the rest of the group.
Hope to see you there!
Source: Meetup: Lancaster Freethought Society
